what: Bible §32.1 coverage floors for the two areas furthest below them, after 114 new behaviour tests.
command: uv run coverage run --branch --source=src/searcher/campaigns,src/searcher/sources -m pytest tests/unit tests/property tests/integration -q -p no:randomly
verdict: Both areas remain below both floors. Neither meets §32.1.
note: A narrower run over tests/unit and tests/property alone reports campaigns 59.7/50.0 and sources 71.4/56.8. The floor is only meaningful against a stated suite, and the numbers above are the full one. Quoting the narrow figures as the project's coverage would understate it; quoting them as the floor would be a different error.
